entries.title: Acts 15:1
segments: And certain ones who came down from Judea taught the brothers, [saying], Unless you are circumcised according to the custom of Moses, you cannot be saved.

entries.title: Acts 15:2
segments: Therefore dissension and not a little disputation occurring by Paul and Barnabas, they appointed Paul and Barnabas and certain others of them to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.

entries.title: Acts 15:3
segments: And indeed being set forward by the church, they passed through Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the nations. And they caused great joy to all the brothers.

entries.title: Acts 15:4
segments: And arriving in Jerusalem, they were received by the church, and [by] the apostles and elders. And [they] declared all things that God had done with them.

entries.title: Acts 15:5
segments: But some of those from the sect of the Pharisees, having believed, rose up, saying, It was necessary to circumcise them and to command [them] to keep the law of Moses.

entries.title: Acts 15:6
segments: And the apostles and elders were assembled to see about this matter.

entries.title: Acts 15:7
segments: And after much disputing, Peter rose up and said to them, Men, brothers, you recognize that from ancient days God chose among us [that] through my mouth the nations [should] hear the word of the gospel, and believe.

entries.title: Acts 15:8
segments: And God, who knows the hearts, bore them witness, giving them the Holy Spirit even as to us.

entries.title: Acts 15:9
segments: And He put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.

entries.title: Acts 15:10
segments: Now therefore why do you tempt God by putting a yoke on the neck of the disciples, a yoke which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

entries.title: Acts 15:11
segments: But we believe that through the grace of [the] Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, according to which manner they also believed.

entries.title: Acts 15:12
segments: And all the multitude kept silent and listened to Barnabas and Paul declaring what miracles and wonders God had worked among the nations through them.

entries.title: Acts 15:13
segments: And after they were silent, James answered, saying, Men, brothers, listen to me.

entries.title: Acts 15:14
segments: Even as Simon has declared [how] God [at] the first visited the nations to take out of them a people for His name.

entries.title: Acts 15:15
segments: And the words of the prophets agree to this; as it is written,

entries.title: Acts 15:16
segments: "After this I will return and will build again the tabernacle of David [which] has fallen down; and I will build again its ruins, and I will set it up,

entries.title: Acts 15:17
segments: so those men who are left might seek after the Lord, and all the nations on whom My name has been called, says the Lord, who does all these things."

entries.title: Acts 15:18
segments: All His works are known to God from eternity.

entries.title: Acts 15:19
segments: Therefore my judgment is that we do not trouble those who have turned to God from among the nations,

entries.title: Acts 15:20
segments: but that we write to them that they should abstain from pollutions of idols, and [from] fornication, and [from] things strangled, and from blood.

entries.title: Acts 15:21
segments: For Moses from ages past has those in every city proclaiming him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.

entries.title: Acts 15:22
segments: Then it pleased the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men from them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; Judas, whose last name was Barsabas; and Silas, chief men among the brothers.

entries.title: Acts 15:23
segments: And they wrote these things by their hand: The apostles and elders and brothers [send] greeting to the brothers, from [the] nations in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia.

entries.title: Acts 15:24
segments: Because we have heard that certain ones who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, Be circumcised and keep the law! (to whom we gave no such command);

entries.title: Acts 15:25
segments: it seemed [good] to us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

entries.title: Acts 15:26
segments: men who have given up their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Acts 15:27
segments: Therefore we have sent Judas and Silas, who will also announce [to you] the same things by word.

entries.title: Acts 15:28
segments: For it seemed [good] to the Holy Spirit and to us to lay on you no greater burden than these necessary things:

entries.title: Acts 15:29
segments: that you abstain from meats offered to idols, and [from] blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication; from which, if you keep yourselves, you shall do well. Be prospered.

entries.title: Acts 15:30
segments: Then indeed they being let go, they came to Antioch. And gathering the multitude, [they] delivered the letter.

entries.title: Acts 15:31
segments: And when they had read [it], they rejoiced at the comfort.

entries.title: Acts 15:32
segments: And Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, exhorted the brothers with many words and confirmed [them].

entries.title: Acts 15:33
segments: And remaining for a time, they were let go in peace from the brothers to the apostles.

entries.title: Acts 15:34
segments: But it pleased Silas to remain there.

entries.title: Acts 15:35
segments: Also Paul and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the gospel, the Word of the Lord, with many others also.

entries.title: Acts 15:36
segments: And some days afterward, Paul said to Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brothers in every city where we have announced the Word of the Lord, how they are doing.

entries.title: Acts 15:37
segments: And Barnabas determined to take with [them] John, he being called Mark.

entries.title: Acts 15:38
segments: But Paul thought it well not to take that one with [them], he having withdrawn form them from Pamphylia, and did not go with them to the work.

entries.title: Acts 15:39
segments: Then there was sharp feeling, as to separate them from each other. And taking Mark, Barnabas sailed to Cyprus.

entries.title: Acts 15:40
segments: But choosing Silas, Paul went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God,

entries.title: Acts 15:41
segments: passing through Syria and Cilicia, making the churches strong.
